title: Membership among initial smaller elements
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $b,c\in\alpha$, and let $l$ be a list whose entries are pairwise strictly increasing. Then $c$ belongs to the initial segment of $l$ consisting of entries less than $b$ if and only if $c$ belongs to $l$ and $c<b$.
hypotheses_covered: The entries of $l$ are pairwise strictly increasing
